errors.description: fusion_input_q is a multi-bit value produced in imu_clk and sampled directly in fusion_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
imu_ready_pulse_q is a one-cycle imu_clk pulse consumed directly in fusion_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
imu_ready_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample fusion_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in fusion_event_o.
fusion_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector fusion_mode_q before decoding in fusion_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
imu_rst_n is used as data inside fusion_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
host_snapshot_q combines imu_clk payload state with fusion_clk status state in host_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
